title: 100-Mode 10x10 Gaussian Grid (Release 0.7 Zero-Sigma Cloud Cohort)
intuition: Explicitly scoped release 0.7 zero-sigma cloud cohort variant of `grid100`. Iconic Law 1 representational-geometry benchmark: learn all 100 tightly separated 2D Gaussian clusters (10x10 grid, 33.3-sigma valleys) scored on clean live outputs with strict precision (>= 0.97-0.99), balanced mass, and accurate per-mode covariance on an untouched holdout.
failure_mode: Unimodal continuous priors hit the super-exponential Borell-TIS Lipschitz cliff, producing heavy valley bridge mass (24%-54% precision vs >= 97% required) and thin or empty clusters.
protocol_notes: Explicit Release 0.7 zero-sigma particle-cloud cohort (z_dim=4, P=20,000, B=256); never pooled with standard MoG `grid100`.
